package contracts_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/contracts"
	rs "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/jsonrpc/contracts/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	audit struct {
		block    error
		t        *testing.T
		results  atomic.Int32
		receives atomic.Int32
		opens    atomic.Int32
	}
	service struct {
		done chan struct{}
	}
)

func TestMountedWebSocketOperations(t *testing.T) {
	a := &audit{t: t}
	implementation := &service{done: make(chan struct{})}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	rs.Mount(mux, rs.New(implementation.HandleStream, svc.NewEndpoints(implementation, a), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, &websocket.Upgrader{}, loomhttp.WebSocketConfig{}))
	server := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer server.Close()
	conn, response, err := websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial("ws"+strings.TrimPrefix(server.URL, "http")+"/ws", nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	if response != nil {
		require.NoError(t, response.Body.Close())
	}
	require.NoError(t, conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(3*time.Second)))
	require.NoError(t, conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","params":{"value":"input"},"id":"one"}`)))
	for _, want := range []string{"input:received:result"} {
		_, body, err := conn.ReadMessage()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Contains(t, string(body), want)
	}
	require.NoError(t, conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, []byte(`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"watch","params":{"value":"error"},"id":"two"}`)))
	_, body, err := conn.ReadMessage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Contains(t, string(body), `"error":`)
	require.Contains(t, string(body), `"id":"two"`)
	require.NoError(t, conn.Close())
	select {
	case <-implementation.done:
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("stream handler did not finish after peer disconnect")
	}
	require.Equal(t, int32(1), a.results.Load())
	require.Equal(t, int32(2), a.receives.Load())
	require.Equal(t, int32(2), a.opens.Load())
}

func TestIncomingFailureCannotDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	sentinel := errors.New("interceptor rejected message")
	a := &audit{t: t, block: sentinel}
	called := false
	endpoint := svc.WrapWatchEndpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
		called = true
		return nil, nil
	}, a)
	_, err := endpoint(context.Background(), &svc.WatchPayload{})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
	require.False(t, called)
	require.Zero(t, a.results.Load())
}

func (a *audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *svc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, "contracts", info.Service())
	require.Equal(a.t, "Watch", info.Method())
	switch info.CallType() {
	case loom.InterceptorStreamingRecv:
		if a.block != nil {
			return nil, a.block
		}
		value, err := next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		payload := info.ServerStreamingPayload(value)
		payload.SetValue(payload.Value() + ":received")
		a.receives.Add(1)
		return value, nil
	case loom.InterceptorUnary:
		value, err := next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result := info.Result(value)
		result.SetValue(result.Value() + ":result")
		a.results.Add(1)
		return value, nil
	default:
		a.t.Errorf("unexpected call type %v", info.CallType())
		return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
	}
}

func (a *audit) Observe(ctx context.Context, info *svc.ObserveInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	require.Equal(a.t, loom.InterceptorUnary, info.CallType())
	a.opens.Add(1)
	return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
}

func (s *service) HandleStream(ctx context.Context, stream svc.Stream) error {
	defer close(s.done)
	for {
		if err := stream.Recv(ctx); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
}

func (s *service) Watch(ctx context.Context, p *svc.WatchPayload) (*svc.WatchResult, error) {
	if *p.Value == "error:received" {
		return nil, errors.New("service error")
	}
	return &svc.WatchResult{Value: p.Value}, nil
}
